# DOT Hazmat Transportation: General Awareness Training

> 4-hour online introduction to the U.S. DOT Hazardous Materials Regulations (49 CFR Parts 171-180), covering the general awareness and security awareness training requirements of the HMR. Suitable for initial and recurrent training. Available in English and Spanish. Offered by HAZWOPER OSHA Training (https://hazwoper-osha.com).

## Key facts
- Duration: 4 hours; 2 modules, 10 lessons, final exam
- Credits: 0.4 CEU
- Price: $99.99 per person; bulk pricing available
- Delivery: 100% online, 24/7, audio playback; SCORM, virtual classroom and in-person formats also available
- Languages: English, Spanish
- Certificate: downloadable on passing; valid 3 years (recurrent training at least every three years)
- Anyone who signs a hazardous waste manifest offering hazmat for transport needs this training

## Lessons
Module 1: Hazardous Materials Regulations
1. Regulatory Overview
2. Hazard Classes and Divisions
3. Hazardous Materials Table, Part 1
4. Hazardous Materials Table, Part 2
5. Preparation of Shipping Papers
Module 2: Packaging and Labeling
6. General Packaging Requirements
7. General Marking Requirements
8. General Labeling Requirements
9. General Placarding Requirements
10. Security and Safety Plans

## Who should take it
Shippers offering hazmat in commerce; people who design, manufacture, inspect, recondition, repair or test hazmat packaging; anyone handling hazmat packages; people who mark or label packages; drivers responsible for hazmat in transit; hazardous waste manifest signers.
